title: Amid backlash, Facebook tries to save face
summary: Facebook is facing backlash from privacy advocates and users concerned about its new social plug-ins and "Instant Personalization" program, despite the company's claims of increased referral traffic for partners. Security vulnerabilities at partner sites like Yelp and declining brand perception among older demographics are compounding Facebook's challenges, prompting discussions with lawmakers amidst calls for legal action.

title: Color Kindle 'still a long way out,' Amazon CEO says
summary: Amazon.com Inc. CEO Jeff Bezos announced that a color version of the Kindle e-reader is "still a long way out" due to technical challenges with "electronic ink" displays. He contrasted this with tablet computers like Apple's iPad, which use LCD screens capable of color but consume more power and are harder to see in sunlight. Bezos also hinted at the potential growth of Amazon Web Services, suggesting it could eventually rival Amazon's retail business.
